name: Vireo
fantasy: The storm-kite runner. Charges you up shot by shot, then runs straight through you and comes out the other side with the dash back.
silhouette: the copper rod mast and kite pennant on the back

card.loop: Every hit loads a Spark onto the target; at 4 they're Live. Wirerun through a Live foe for a Blowout: big damage and your dash back at once.
card.dash: Wirerun: hold to stretch it (5 to 8.5m), let go to streak forward; shots pass through you and anyone you cross takes a hit.
card.passive: Sparks: your hits stack up to 4 on a foe (Live). Wirerun through a Live foe: Blowout, and the dash resets. A knock heals you.
card.rmb: Coilshot: hold to charge a heavy round that throws the first foe back; slammed into a wall or another foe, they're stunned.
card.e: Skycall: mark a spot; a moment later lightning flings everyone there along your aim and pins them to the ground (no dashing).

weapons.coilcaster: A copper coil on the forearm that spits bolts which pass through everyone in a line; each hit loads a Spark.

passive.name: Sparks
passive.desc: Your bolts, Coilshot and Skycall each load a Spark onto what they hit (up to 4, 4.5s, refreshed by every hit). At 4 the foe is Live: a ring of crackling pips over them that everyone sees. Wirerun through a Live foe for a Blowout: 8 damage plus 15% of their health, a T4 hit, their Sparks spent and your dash recharged on the spot. Knocking a hunter down heals you for 15% of your health.

dash.name: Wirerun
dash.desc: Press and hold: a lane grows from 5 to 8.5m over 0.45s for everyone to see; let go and you streak along it. Shots pass straight through you for the whole run, and every foe you cross takes 10. Crossing a Live foe is a Blowout and gives the dash straight back. Picking up a charge mote also gives it back.

variants.tap: A quick Coilshot (it still takes 0.33s to wind): 9 damage, 6m, a short throw.
variants.hold: Hold up to 1s: up to 15 damage, 13m and a big throw. A foe thrown into a wall or into another foe is stunned 0.8s (so is the one they hit). Hitting a hunter drops a charge mote 0.5s later: pick it up for your dash back.

e.name: Skycall
e.desc: Mark a spot up to 9m away (a filling ring everyone sees); 0.55s later lightning strikes it: 14 damage, a Spark, and everyone inside is flung along your aim and Grounded for 1.2s (no dashing). It also flings any charge mote it catches, so you can steal a rival's.

rank3.dash: the run's own hit deals double

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 10s -> 8s, damage +30%; +20% damage on top.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; the run's own hit deals double.

tells.half: crackling pips over every target with Sparks, one per Spark
tells.full: a Live foe: four bright pips spinning in a ring, a hum and arcs to the ground
tells.dash_spent: a fading wire streak where the run went
